data.title: 埃塔 · 给编号者的技术讲座
data.description: 庭园讲堂里，埃塔站在写满公式的黑板前给编号者们讲史莱姆材料的特性。讲到第三页，她的声音越来越小——台下所有人都在祈祷她别睡着。
data.location: shadow garden lecture hall with a blackboard full of formulas and rows of trainees
data.action: lecturing before a formula-covered blackboard, voice trailing off, eyelids drooping mid-sentence
data.lighting: 讲堂窗户透入的明亮日光
data.promptProse: Eta's lecture on slime materials is brilliant and increasingly quiet. The trainees take notes and pray she stays awake.
data.animaCaption: The formulas are perfect. The lecturer is at 12% consciousness and falling.
